deployments_detail.use: Warren - AI Investment Mentor chatbot (built with startup AI Hay) providing securities consulting and personalized financial guidance

"Warren - AI Investment Mentor": a financial chatbot co-developed with Vietnamese AI startup AI Hay to provide investment education, securities guidance and data-analysis coaching, and to connect users to Vietcap's account-opening and online advisory services. Announced via an MOU signed 28 October 2025; described as in development, not yet in production. [AI Hay (Vietnamese AI Q&A platform startup)]

Integration of Vietcap's proprietary financial and securities knowledge base (Vietcap IQ and Vietcap Academy content) into the AI Hay consumer AI platform, so AI Hay's 15M+ users can query reliable Vietcap financial data with higher answer accuracy. Announced in the October 2025 MOU; planned. [AI Hay]
deployments_detail.value: AI Hay has 15M+ downloads (partner-side reach figure; not a Vietcap-specific metric)

deployments_detail.use: AI Hay Pro for Vietcap: a customized enterprise AI package that AI Hay will provide for Vietcap's internal use to optimize workflows and boost employee productivity. Announced as part of the October 2025 MOU; planned/announced, not confirmed in production. [AI Hay]

Vietcap AI News: an AI platform that automatically analyzes and consolidates market news from many sources by topic, ranks news relevance based on stock ticker codes, and includes a voice/text-to-speech reading feature so investors get personalized, multi-source market intelligence on one platform. Described in the 2024 annual report and launched publicly around May 2024. [none disclosed (in-house; annual report notes collaboration with reputable national technology partners)]

Vietcap IQ: financial analysis and stock research platform providing portfolio tracking, company valuation analytics, industry rankings, and market-trend forecasting tools for the Vietnamese market. Grouped by Vietcap under its AI-driven data-analysis ecosystem alongside AI News and AI Trading. [in-house]

AI Trading: an AI-based trading/analytics platform, the third pillar (with Vietcap IQ and Vietcap AI News) of Vietcap's technology-analytics and Smart Data ecosystem, designed to support investors in dynamic markets. Named as a developed/operational platform in the 2025 annual report. [in-house]
